Transaction in Own Shares AI Summary Close X Between 2 and 6 November 2026 Barratt Redrow purchased 2,425,697 ordinary shares for cancellation under its £386m buyback programme, paying daily VWAPs of 330.72p (2 Nov), 327.89p (3 Nov), 331.91p (5 Nov) and 329.34p (6 Nov) and spending approximately £8.0m in the Disclosure Period. To date the Company has cancelled 42,581,416 shares, equivalent to c.£140m (c.36% of the £386m Programme) at an average execution price near 330p; following cancellations it holds no treasury shares and has 1,367,938,837 ordinary shares and voting rights outstanding. Ongoing repurchases reduce share count and are likely supportive of EPS and the share price. Disclaimer* Barratt Redrow PLC 09 November 2026 9 November 2026 Barratt Redrow plc Transaction in Own Shares Barratt Redrow plc, ISIN: GB0000811801 (the "Company", "Barratt Redrow") announces that during the period from 2 November 2026 to 6 November 2026 (the "Disclosure Period") it has purchased for cancellation the following number of ordinary shares of 10 pence each from Barclays Bank plc ("Barclays") as part of its £386 million share repurchase programme announced on 15 July 2026 (the "Programme"). All shares were purchased from Barclays as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange ("LSE").
